speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your 8-month-old son's feeding difficulties and abdominal distension, can you tell me if he has been vomiting, and if so, is the vomit green or bile-stained?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that update; the tenderness is a concerning sign. Has he passed any stools recently, and if so, do you notice any blood or mucus mixed in? Please also tell me if he has had any episodes of sudden, intense crying followed by relief.

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease (Congenital Aganglionic Megacolon)
